body:
Adds `research/control-twin`: exact real cost of a scalar LQR controller designed in a twin with the wrong actuator gain, the instability band the twin does not warn about, closed-loop non-identifiability without dither, and a dithered retune with a matched delta-method regret law. Includes 10 tests, seeded experiments, whitepaper, README bullet and site entry (`python site/build.py` prints ok).
